member.name: M:Gsharp.Concurrency.tick(System.TimeSpan)
member.summary:
A timer that fires repeatedly, every period — G#'s time.Tick.
Unlike after, this one keeps firing until it is disposed, so it leaks a CLR timer if it is dropped: hold it in a using let, or dispose it when the loop that selects on it ends. At most one tick is pending at a time — a consumer that falls behind sees ticks dropped rather than queued.
member.param: The interval between firings.
member.returns: A selectable that yields each firing time.
